solution:
The correct answer is __**a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydrogen (H): Group 1**
 
• **Helium (He): Group 18**
 
• **Beryllium (Be): Group 2**
 
• **Boron (B): Group 13**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5cd51e9572830dbb04f2625a02821286a64b5bc0d5e8cbe232cf0866c20c3e1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Hydrogen:**

 
• It is the **lightest and most abundant element** in the universe
 
• Hydrogen is used in a variety of industrial processes, including **petroleum refining** and **ammonia production**
 
• It is also being explored as a **potential clean energy source** for **fuel cells and power generation**
 
• Hydrogen is a key component of** water **and many **organic compounds**

**Helium:**

 
• Helium is the** second-lightest** and **second-most abundant element** in the universe
 
• It is used in **cryogenics**, as a coolant for **superconducting magnets** and in medical MRI machines
 
• Helium is also used in** gas chromatography**, **leak detection**, and as a **lifting gas in balloons and airships**
 
• It is **non-toxic**, **inert**, and has the **lowest boiling point **of any element

**Beryllium:**

 
• Beryllium is a** lightweight, strong metal with high melting and boiling points**
 
• It is used in** aerospace, defense**, and **nuclear applications** due to its strength and ability to withstand high temperatures
 
• Beryllium is also used in** X-ray windows, computer components, **and as a **moderator in nuclear reactors**
 
• Exposure to beryllium dust or fumes can cause** lung disease**, so proper safety measures are essential

**Boron:**

 
• Boron is a **metalloid** element that is essential for** plant growth** and is used in** fertilizers**
 
• It is also used in **borosilicate glass, ceramics,** and as a **dopant** in **semiconductors**
 
• Boron compounds are used in a variety of applications, including** flame retardants, insecticides, and neutron-absorbing materials**
 
• Boron has a** high melting point **and is known for its **hardness and resistance to heat**
